pairs: in novissimo dierum erit mons domus Domini præparatus in vertice montium,
the mountain of the house of the Lord will be prepared at the top of the mountains and high above the hills.
And the people will flow to it.
let us ascend to the mountain of the Lord
and to the house of the God of Jacob.
et docebit nos de viis suis,
And he will teach us about his ways,
and we will walk in his paths.”
For the law will go forth from Zion,
and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
And he will judge among the many peoples,
et corripiet gentes fortes usque in longinquum:
and he will correct strong nations, even from afar.
et concident gladios suos in vomeres,
And they will cut up their swords into plows,
non sumet gens adversus gentem gladium,
Nation will not take up the sword against nation,
and they will no longer learn to wage war.
Et sedebit vir subtus vitem suam et subtus ficum suam,
And a man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree,
and there will be no one to fear,
quia os Domini exercituum locutum est.
for the mouth of the Lord of hosts has spoken.
Quia omnes populi ambulabunt unusquisque in nomine dei sui;
nos autem ambulabimus in nomine Domini Dei nostri,
each one in the name of his god.
But we will walk in the name of the Lord our God,
I will gather together the lame.
And I will recover her whom I had rejected,
and her whom I had afflicted.
And I will place the lame within the remnant,
and she who had been in distress,
et regnabit Dominus super eos in monte Sion,
And the Lord will reign over them on Mount Zion,
ex hoc nunc et usque in æternum.
from the present time and even unto eternity.
cloudy tower of the flock of the daughter of Zion,
even to you it will come.
And the first power will arrive,
the kingdom to the daughter of Jerusalem.
Now, why have you come together in grief?
Is there not a king in you,
or has your counselor gone away?
quia comprehendit te dolor sicut parturientem?
For sorrow has overtaken you, like the pain of giving birth.
quia nunc egredieris de civitate, et habitabis in regione,
For now you must depart from the city and dwell in the countryside,
and you will approach even to Babylon.
ibi redimet te Dominus de manu inimicorum tuorum.
There the Lord will redeem you from the hand of your adversaries.
Et nunc congregatæ sunt super te gentes multæ,
And now many peoples have been gathered together against you,
et aspiciat in Sion oculus noster.
and let our eyes gaze upon Zion.”
Ipsi autem non cognoverunt cogitationes Domini,
But they have not known the thoughts of the Lord,
and they have not understood his counsel.
quia congregavit eos quasi fœnum areæ.
For he has gathered them together like hay on a threshing floor.
For I will set your horn like iron,
and I will set your hoofs like brass.
And you will shatter many peoples,
and you will immolate their spoils for the Lord,
et fortitudinem eorum Domino universæ terræ.
and their strength for the Lord of the whole earth.
